text.p: Following are the main stories in Slovenia's Monday morning newspapers:
- Eighteen-year-old ski-jumper Primoz Peterka became the first Slovenian to win the overall ski-jumping World Cup.
- Parliament is expected to accept the government's proposal to freeze salaries of governmental and parliamentary officials this week.
- Slovenian Minister of Economic Affairs Metod Dragonja started a two-day visit to Russia on Sunday in order to improve economic relations between the two countries.
- Foreign Minister Zoran Thaler is visiting Brussels today where he will attend a meeting of foreign ministers of the countries of the European Union and of the EU associate members.
- Petrol trader OMV Istrabenz, the Slovenian partner of Austria's OMV, said it expected its market stake in Slovenia to increase to 30 percent by 2000 from the current 23 percent.
- About 66.7 percent of Slovenians said they supported the policy of the government of Prime Minister Janez Drnovsek, an opinion poll showed.
